svg.text: Gauge R&R study – 10 carriages × 3 operators × 3 trials (average + range method)
Characteristic: carriage height H deviation (µm), electronic height gauge 0.1 µm, tolerance class H ± 40 µm = 80 µm
– the gauge can measure this characteristic.
Operator B reads ≈ 0.8 µm high: train / check
